Title: PM Modi extends greetings to citizens on Ayurveda Day, calls Ayurveda a path to healthy, balanced life
Text:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has extended his greetings to the citizens on the occasion of Ayurveda Day today. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that Ayurveda is not merely a method of treatment but a powerful means of a healthy and balanced lifestyle. The Prime Minister called upon people to resolve to embrace this rich heritage more firmly.
AYUSH Minister Prataprao Jadhav also extended greetings to all the citizens, Ayurvedic physicians, and vaidyas on the occasion of Ayurveda Day. In a social media post, Mr Jadhav called upon the citizens to embrace country’s ancient medical system and build a healthy, prosperous, and self-reliant India.

Title: India committed to eliminating Hepatitis B, C as public health threats by 2030, says Health Secretary
Text:
India has reaffirmed its commitment to combating Viral Hepatitis and eliminating Hepatitis B and C as public health threats by 2030. Addressing a side event of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York, organised by the UN Group of Friends to Eliminate Hepatitis, Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava highlighted India’s comprehensive, people-centred response across prevention, screening, diagnosis, treatment and care.
The Health Secretary said India has strengthened interventions across the continuum from antenatal screening and Hepatitis B immunisation to free diagnosis and treatment, safe blood transfusion services, counselling and rehabilitation support for people who inject drugs. She emphasised the importance of sustained global cooperation, equitable access to prevention, testing and treatment, and stronger health systems to accelerate progress towards the 2030 targets.

Title: PM Modi, LS Speaker pay tributes to poet Ramdhari Singh Dinkar on his birth anniversary
Text:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has paid tributes to the National Poet Ramdhari Singh Dinkar on his birth anniversary today. In a social media post, the Prime Minister said that Mr Dinkar’s fiery poems, brimming with the sentiments of public awakening and national pride, continue to infuse valour, vigour and self-respect into the hearts of the countrymen even today.
Mr Modi added that his works not only enrich literature but also inspire devotion to the motherland. The Prime Minister said that Mr Dinkar’s towering personality and timeless creations will guide generations of Indians for ages to come.
Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla also paid tributes to the National Poet Ramdhari Singh Dinkar. In a social media post, the Lok Sabha Speaker said, in the firmament of Hindi literature, Mr Dinkar’s place is not merely as a great poet but as a litterateur whose pen gave voice to the nation’s consciousness, public sentiments, and social concerns.
Mr Birla said that Dinkar’s timeless works, including Rashmirathi, Kurukshetra, Urvashi, Renuka and Four Chapters of Indian Culture have enriched Hindi literature and offered a fresh perspective on Indian society and national thought. He added that Mr Dinkar’s immortal literary legacy will continue to inspire Indian literature and national reflection.

Title: IMD forecasts heavy to very heavy rain in Chhattisgarh, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Telangana
Text:
Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall with isolated extremely heavy rainfall over Chhattisgarh, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Odisha and Telangana today.
The weather agency has predicted heavy rainfall over Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Meghalaya, Sikkim, Bihar, Jharkhand, Interior Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, Konkan, Goa, Maharashtra and West Bengal.
Thunderstorm accompanied with lightning may prevail over Madhya Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura and Rayalaseema today.

Title: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal says integrated offices will provide businesses a common point to access govt services
Text:
Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has said that integrated commerce and industry offices are being envisioned in major cities to provide businesses with a common point of access to multiple government departments and agencies. He made the announcement at a stakeholder workshop organised by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade in New Delhi yesterday. Minister of State for Commerce and Industry Jitin Prasada also attended the programme.
Mr. Goyal said the government is working to strengthen export facilitation through both physical and digital mechanisms. He said, instead of setting up separate offices of different departments at various locations, integrated offices will help businesses access multiple services at a single point.
The Minister also announced the development of a digital platform, Trade Connect, which will provide exporters with product-wise and HSN-code-wise information. This will include tariffs in destination countries, Free Trade Agreement opportunities and procedures for availing FTA benefits.
Mr. Goyal said the platform will use digital and AI-enabled tools to help businesses identify potential export opportunities and address infrastructure gaps.
The workshop brought together representatives of industry associations, trade bodies and sectoral organisations. Discussions focused on Ease of Doing Business reforms, trade facilitation, opportunities arising from India’s Free Trade Agreements, and challenges faced by industry in accessing markets and navigating regulatory procedures.

Title: PM Modi Unveils Logo for Birth Centenary Celebrations of Sri Vishwesha Tirtha Swamiji
Text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Sri Sri Vishwaprasanna Tirtha Swamiji of Sri Pejavara Adhokshaja Matha, Udupi, along with other dignitaries in New Delhi today . On the occasion, Mr Modi unveiled the logo of the Birth Centenary Celebrations of Padma Vibhushan Yatikula Chakravarti Sri Vishwesha Tirtha Swamiji. In a social media post, Mr Modi said, the life of devotion, learning and service of Sri Vishwesha Tirtha Swami continues to inspire countless people. He said, the various initiatives being undertaken in the run-up to his birth centenary will further carry forward his noble ideals.

Title: 11th Ayurveda Day to be Celebrated in Nagpur Tomorrow
Text:
The 11th Ayurveda Day will be celebrated in Nagpur tomorrow by the Ministry of Ayush, based on the theme “Ayurveda for a Healthy Future.” The inaugural ceremony will be held at the Kavivarya Suresh Bhat Auditorium in Nagpur from 9 to 10 AM.
Informing about this event, Vice-Chancellor of the National Institute of Ayurveda, Jaipur, Dr. Sanjeev Sharma, said that this year’s Ayurveda Day will focus on strengthening Ayurveda through evidence, research and innovation, while promoting community health and well-being.
During the event, Safety Dossiers on Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) and Chandrashura (Lepidium sativum), along with Standard Treatment Guidelines for dermatological disorders, will also be released. The programme will also witness the launch of “From Traditional Wisdom to Global Leadership: Ayush Vision 2030” Report. It will also witness the Status Report on Ayush-related Inventions in India and the Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences and Ayurveda Gyan Naipunya Initiative Assessment Scale Web Portal.
Ayurveda institutions, practitioners and various stakeholders from across the country and the world will participate in the 11th Ayurveda Day celebrations.

Title: India, Japan Discuss Defence Technology Cooperation, Joint Exercises and Indo-Pacific Security
Text:
India and Japan today discussed strengthening defence technology cooperation, joint military exercises and regional security in the Indo-Pacific. The discussions took place in New Delhi between Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh and a visiting delegation of Japanese parliamentarians led by Liberal Democratic Party leader Taro Kono. The Ministry of Defence said both sides held a productive exchange of views on enhancing bilateral defence technology collaboration and cooperation for peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific.
The Japanese delegation, visiting India under the India-Japan Distinguished Visitors Programme, also discussed economic security, supply-chain resilience, trade, investment, technology and innovation with Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri. The delegation also visited IISc, ISRO and Bharat Electronics Limited in Bengaluru, highlighting the growing cooperation between India and Japan in AI, space, defence and technology.

Title: Union Minister H.D Kumaraswamy Calls for Stronger India-EU Cooperation in Clean Energy, E-Mobility and Industrial Decarbonisation
Text:
Union Minister of Heavy Industries H.D. Kumaraswamy today said that India and the European Union can combine their strengths to accelerate the clean energy transition and advance sustainable transport through innovative e-mobility solutions. The Minister held discussions with a delegation of the Committee on Industry, Research and Energy (ITRE) of the European Parliament in New Delhi. The discussions were focused on strengthening India-EU cooperation in industrial development, clean energy, electric mobility and industrial decarbonisation. Mr Kumaraswamy emphasised the potential for deeper cooperation in trade, investment, technology and global supply chains. The Minister highlighted India’s efforts towards industrial decarbonisation and energy transition, including BHEL’s indigenous gasification technology and the roadmap for greening the steel sector through scrap recycling, utilisation of steel slag and circular economy practices.
The delegation appreciated India’s efforts towards accelerating electric mobility, strengthening domestic manufacturing and advancing industrial decarbonisation. The members also expressed interest in further strengthening India-EU cooperation in clean technologies, sustainable mobility and advanced energy solutions.

Title: National Film Awards: Actor Anant Nag Honoured with Dadasaheb Phalke Award; Article 370 Wins Best Feature Film
Text:
In a historic ceremony held against the grand backdrop of the Statue of Unity in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat, President Droupadi Murmu presented the 72nd National Film Awards, honouring cinematic excellence for the year 2024 across feature, non-feature, and writing categories. A total of 92 awardees were recognized during the event.
Legendary actor Anant Nag was honoured with the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 for his outstanding contribution to Indian cinema spanning over five decades. In the feature film section, the political thriller Article 370 bagged the Swarna Kamal for Best Feature Film. Director Randeep Hooda received the Best Debut Director award for Swatantrya Veer Savarkar, while Nag Ashwin Singireddy’s sci-fi film Kalki 2898 AD won the award for Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment. Rajkumar Periasamy received the Best Direction trophy for the Tamil movie Amaran. The Telugu film 35- Chinna Katha Kaadu took home the Best Children’s Film honor.
In the acting categories, the Best Actor in a Leading Role award was jointly presented to veteran actor Mammootty for Bramayugam and Kartik Aaryan for Chandu Champion. Yami Gautam won the Best Actress in a Leading Role award for her performance in Article 370. Sanjay Mishra secured the Best Supporting Actor award for Bhakshak, while the Best Supporting Actress title was shared by Sachana Namidass for Maharaja and Ropashree Varkady for Mithya.
In the non-feature section, Marathi film Bhangaar won the Best Non-Feature Film award, while director Aanand L Rai won Best Direction for his work Statue of Unity – Ekta ka Prateek. In the writing on cinema categories, Sanjeev Shrivastava bagged the Swarna Kamal for Best Film Critic.
Bollywood actor Kartik Aaryan expressed his deep gratitude upon receiving his first National Film Award for Chandu Champion. He described the honour as a milestone in his artistic journey.
Addressing the film fraternity, President Droupadi Murmu today highlighted the cultural strength and diversity of Indian cinema. The President emphasised the important role of cinema in reflecting India’s varied languages, traditions and social experiences. She said that films not only entertain audiences but also connect people across regions and help showcase India’s rich cultural heritage.
In his address, Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw congratulated all the award winners and acknowledged the contribution of technicians, cinematographers and other members working behind the scenes. He also congratulated the winner of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024, Anant Nag, and appreciated his contribution to the film world spanning more than five decades. The Minister said that the idea of taking the National Film Awards to different tourist destinations draws inspiration from India’s G20 presidency, when more than 200 meetings were held in over 60 cities across the country. Mr Vaishnaw invited all States and Union Territories to identify an important tourist destination in their respective regions so that they can host a future edition of the National Film Awards.

Title: India condemns Pakistani airstrikes on Afghanistan’s Kunar and Paktika provinces
Text:
India has strongly condemned Pakistan’s airstrikes on Afghanistan in its Kunar and Paktika provinces. Addressing media in New Delhi this evening, External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said such instances of aggression against a sovereign neighbour go against regional peace and security. He reaffirmed New Delhi’s steadfast support for Afghanistan, its independence, sovereignty, and territorial integrity, as also for the welfare and well-being of its people. The spokesperson offered condolences on the civilian lives lost in the airstrikes and wished for speedy recovery of the injured.
On Pakistan’s Field Marshal Asim Munir’s statement that Pakistan’s armed forces remain determined to defeat terrorism, Mr Jaiswal said Pakistan needs to demonstrate action and firm commitment. He stated that Islamabad must take credible action against cross-border terrorism before the world believes in what they say.
On Pakistan’s ruling by the Court of Arbitration on Indus Water Treaty, Mr Jasiwal said the so-called ruling is not a ruling by the Permanent Court of Arbitration, as sought to be projected by Pakistan, but by an illegally constituted Court. He said India sees this as just one more attempt by Pakistan at distorting the reality. He stated that Pakistan has a habit of misrepresenting facts and propagating falsehoods to serve its malicious propaganda.
Replying to another query, the spokesperson informed that External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar met with his Ukrainian counterpart yesterday. In this meeting, Dr Jaishankar discussed the recent developments in the Russia-Ukraine conflict. The External Affairs Minister once again put forth India’s point that dialogue and diplomacy is the way forward for peaceful resolution. The spokesperson added that India is in touch with both sides and have told them that India is ready to contribute in any way that it can. He expressed India’s hope that there will be a peaceful resolution of the conflict through dialogue and diplomacy.
On India-Bangladesh ties, Mr Jaiswal said that India desires a positive, constructive and forward-looking relationship with Bangladesh. He said New Delhi is ready to discuss all bilateral issues within the structured mechanisms.

Title: Amit Shah Calls for Decisive Action to Dismantle Drug Networks, Says Govt Targets Drug-Free India by 2029
Text:
Union Home Minister Amit Shah has said that the time has come to take a strong and decisive blow to narcotics, which has become a serious threat to the country and the world. Inaugurating the 3rd National Conference of Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) Heads of States and UTs in New Delhi today, Mr Shah said, with the aim of improving the welfare of the youth, Government has prepared the roadmap 2029. He said, by 2029 Government will collectively succeed in uprooting the drug trade from India. The Home Minister said, the roadmap of drug-free India is very important to achieve Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s goal of creating a Viksit Bharat by 2047. He said, in this fight against drugs, India is moving towards complete victory by setting targets , timeline and accountability. Mr Shah said, now there is a need to go from Meeting to Mission, Reporting to Result, Seizure to End of Network and Case to Conviction. He said, the goal should be to make ANTF an Anti-Narco Mission Command. The Minister called upon officers to move forward with the aim of dismantling the network instead of a Seizure-centric approach. He said, district will have to be made the basic unit of fight against drugs. Mr Shah informed that Nashamukt Mitras will visit 10 lakh schools, colleges and institutions of the country to create awareness among the youth and sensitize the campus directors. He said, along with backwards-forward investigation, financial investigation and finding digital links should be the priority. The Home Minister said, the cartel has to be attacked at three levels, entry point, interstate distribution system and local cell network in the districts. He said, a campaign will have to be launched to send back the foreign accused present in India and blacklist them, so that they cannot come to India again. He added that the fugitives who are supplying drugs to the country from abroad should be caught and brought before the Indian courts. The Home Minister asked officers to make the entire process of converting every ANTF information into actionable intelligence a part of the state’s police culture.
During the event, Mr Shah also launched the new website of the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB). He released four Television Commercials to create awareness among people about drug abuse. Mr Shah also laid the foundation stones for the new zonal office and residential complex of the NCB in Lucknow and a new zonal office complex in Dehradun.
The two-day conference serves as a powerful platform to safeguard future generations from the menace of drugs. Heads of ANTFs from 36 States and Union Territories are attending the conference, being organised by the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB). Based on the theme of the United Resolve, Shared Responsibility, the conference is focusing on progress of targets assigned to State and UTs ANTFs in recently released Vision Document on Narcotics Control (2026-29).

Title: Centre inks deals with 21 States, UTs for next phase of UDAN scheme
Text:
Twenty-one states and Union Territories have signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoU) with the Civil Aviation Ministry under the next phase of the UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik) scheme in New Delhi today. Speaking on the occasion, Civil Aviation Minister Rammohan Naidu described UDAN as one of the most revolutionary schemes in the country, propelling regional air connectivity across the nation. Highlighting the vision for the next phase, the Minister noted that following the extension of the scheme for another 10 years, the government aims to construct 100 new airports and 200 modern heliports or helipads across the country. He added that the upcoming phase targets facilitating travel for four crore UDAN passengers. Mr Naidu also noted that the aviation-sector jobs have grown from around 3 million in 2014 to nearly 7.7 million today, with the potential to reach 25 million by 2040.
Mr Naidu stated that more than 90 airports have been built over the past decade under UDAN, extending affordable air travel benefits to nearly one crore 54 lakh passengers.
The event also witnessed the launch of the Challenge Mode Portal for Aerodrome Development and the release of the Scheme Document for the next phase of UDAN Route bidding.
Under the Challenge Mode, airport projects will be prioritized and fast-tracked to cut construction timelines down to an 18-month target from the earlier average of two to three years. The route bidding round process will facilitate the expansion of air services to unserved and underserved regions, improving accessibility and mobility and supporting wider economic activity, tourism, trade and employment.

Title: CDSCO Advises Responsible Use of Painkillers and Antibiotics to Reduce Risk of Kidney Disease
Text:
Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) has advised against the indiscriminate use of painkillers and antibiotics, highlighting the associated risk of Chronic Kidney Disease. According to a circular, all drugs, including non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and antibiotics, are required to be sold and distributed in the country on prescription of Registered Medical Practitioner and specialist only. It highlighted that these drugs shall only be used when clinically indicated, in the appropriate dose and for the appropriate duration, and under the supervision of a Registered Medical Practitioner. CDSCO also advised that individuals, particularly those with pre-existing kidney disease or other risk factors for renal impairment, should inform their healthcare professional before using NSAIDS. It also urged the general public to avoid taking antibiotics for self-medication or for conditions where antibiotic treatment is not clinically indicated, such as most uncomplicated viral infections.
It called on healthcare professionals to prescribe NSAIDs and antibiotics only when clinically indicated, after considering the patient’s clinical condition, age, co-morbidities, concomitant medicines and relevant risk factors. It also said that pharmacists and retailers shall not encourage or facilitate self-medication with antibiotics or prescription-only NSAIDS. Meanwhile, it requested Drugs Control Authorities of States and Union Territories to create awareness among healthcare professionals, pharmacists, retailers and the general public regarding the risks associated with indiscriminate use of NSAIDS and antibiotics.

Title: Union Minister Jitendra Singh Holds Talks with European Parliament Delegation on India-EU FTA and Technology Cooperation
Text:
Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh today held a discussion with the European Parliament delegation focusing on effective implementation of India-EU FTA. The delegation, comprising members of the European Parliament’s Committee on Industry, Research and Energy, met Dr Singh in New Delhi. During the meeting, both sides discussed deepening cooperation in Science, Technology and Emerging Technologies.
On the occasion, Dr Singh said the India-EU strategic partnership offers significant opportunities for closer collaboration in areas of mutual priority, with science and research forming an integral part of the partnership. He added that the FTA will open new opportunities for businesses, consumers and skilled professionals and provide further momentum to the multifaceted India-EU strategic partnership.
Member of European Parliament Angelika Winzig said that India is a key strategic partner for the European Union. She said the delegation’s visit was aimed at gaining a deeper understanding of India’s industrial and technology policies and identifying areas for closer cooperation.

Title: PM Modi Highlights India’s Commitment to Protecting Greater One-Horned Rhinoceros on World Rhino Day
Text: On World Rhino Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that India celebrates the magnificent greater one-horned rhinoceros and laud all those at the forefront of its protection. In a social media post, he underlined that Assam now holds nearly 80 percent of the world’s rhino population and Kaziranga’s efforts to end rhino poaching have been extensively appreciated. He informed that rhinos have either returned or are well protected in parts of Bihar and West Bengal. He added that success of reintroduction of rhinos in Dudhwa in Uttar Pradesh is creating history. Mr Modi highlighted the sustained commitment of countrymen towards animal protection and active wildlife management in the range states. Prime Minister Modi stated that Project Rhino has been initiated for financial and technical support to the range states for protection, habitat management, genetic improvement and understanding population dynamics.

Title: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey Highlights Resilience and Expansion of India’s Capital Markets
Text:
The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Chairman, Tuhin Kanta Pandey, has strongly highlighted the remarkable resilience and massive expansion of India’s capital markets. Addressing the eleventh J.P. Morgan India Conference today, the SEBI chief noted that despite severe geopolitical headwinds and fragmented global supply chains, the Indian economy continues to show stellar progress. He revealed that the country’s real GDP grew by 7.8 per cent in the first quarter of the current financial year.
Providing a snapshot of the capital ecosystem, the Chairman stated that India’s equity market today boasts a market capitalization of around five trillion US dollars. He said over the past decade, more than one hundred trillion rupees have been raised through equity and debt issuances. Mr Pandey said the momentum has carried into the current fiscal year, with around six hundred billion rupees raised through Initial Public Offerings so far, out of which 55 per cent represents fresh capital flowing directly into companies. Mr Pandey said outstanding corporate bonds have also surged to about 61 trillion rupees today.
Highlighting a historic surge in public participation, Mr Pandey announced that India now has around 149 million unique securities-market investors. Driven by growing household savings, mutual fund assets have nearly tripled in five years, skyrocketing from 37 trillion rupees to 87 trillion rupees.
Speaking on international capital, the SEBI Chairman stated that Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) remain a crucial pillar, holding assets under custody of around 818 billion US dollars.
Detailing regulatory reforms, Mr Pandey affirmed that SEBI’s priority is to reduce avoidable friction and use technology intelligently while keeping trust at the centre. He highlighted the SWAGAT-FI framework, which has fast-tracked the digital onboarding of over two hundred trusted foreign investors since June this year. SEBI has also launched Demat 2.0, a pilot project for the tokenisation of corporate bonds using Distributed Ledger Technology.
Looking ahead, the Chairman mentioned that SEBI is consulting on new frameworks, including a Credit Risk-o-Meter to help investors better understand credit risks, and stronger cyber-security protocols to bolster market resilience.

Title: PM Modi’s Vision of Jan Seva and Sushasan Drives GeM’s Growth and Expands Digital Public Procurement
Text:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is completing 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through the Government e-Marketplace, GeM.
The Government e-Marketplace, GeM, launched in August 2016, has emerged as a major digital platform for public procurement in the country. The platform brings together buyers and sellers on a common online marketplace. Addressing a post-budget webinar on Ease of living using technology in 2023, Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted how the GeM portal has empowered small business owners and street vendors to participate in government procurement.
Talking to Akashvani News, CEO of GeM, Mihir Kumar, said that the business of GeM has grown from 422 crore rupees in 2016-17 to over twenty lakh crore rupees now.
The sellers on GeM platform have grown from around three thousand to over 25 lakh. With its growing participation from Micro and Small Enterprises, women entrepreneurs, startups and other sellers, GeM is continuing to expand the reach of digital public procurement across the country.

Title: Government Clarifies UPI MDR Will Not Burden Small Merchants or Make Digital Payments Expensive
Text: The Government today clarified that GST on UPI Merchant Discount Rate, or MDR, will not burden small merchants or make digital payments expensive. In a social media post, National Payments Corporation of India  (NPCI) has termed such media reports as incorrect. It said, MDR applies only to person-to-merchant transactions above two thousand rupees. It said person-to-merchant transactions up to two thousand rupees continue to have zero MDR and therefore zero GST impact. NPCI stated that transactions of up to two thousand rupees constitute more than 96 per cent of UPI merchant transaction volume. The GST paid on MDR by a merchant will be adjusted against the GST payable on the sale of goods, in the same manner that input taxes are set off against output tax liability. NPCI said that merchants with monthly UPI receipts of up to one lakh rupees are not liable to pay MDR.

Title: TARANG SHAKTI 2026 Multinational Air Exercise to Begin on 26th September in Jodhpur
Text:
The second edition of the Indian Air Force’s multinational air exercise TARANG SHAKTI 2026 will be conducted from 26th September to 12th October at Air Force Station, Jodhpur and adjoining air bases. The exercise aims to expose all participants to planning and execution of multinational joint combat operations in a realistic contemporary battlespace and derive tactically viable solutions. Eight Friendly Foreign Countries such as Australia, Bangladesh, France, Germany, Greece, Sri Lanka, UAE and USA will participate with air assets, while 32 nations will be attending as observers.
Addressing the press briefing regarding the exercise, Vice Chief of Air Staff Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit said that Tarang Shakti 2026 is about learning from each other, operating with each other, and preparing for the air warfare challenges of tomorrow. He said that the exercise covers a wide canvas of air operations, from counter-air, air defense, and force combat to recce, airlift, air-to-air refueling, and other highly complex mission sets. He added that it also provides an opportunity for our partners to see the growing capabilities of Indian Air space and its independent history.

Title: RBI Absorbs ₹71,971 Crore Surplus Liquidity Through Overnight VRRR Auction
Text:
The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) today absorbed 71,971 crore rupees from the banking system through an overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction. The operation was conducted to absorb surplus liquidity from the system and align overnight money market rates with the benchmark policy repo rate.
According to an official release, the central bank fully accepted all bids received against a total notified auction size of 75,000 crore rupees. The bids were accepted at a cut-off and weighted average rate of 5.24 per cent.
As per the RBI data, currently, surplus liquidity in the banking system is estimated to be around 4.92 lakh crore rupees. To manage these conditions, the central bank also conducted two open market operations (OMO), resulting in sales of Government securities worth 50,000 crore rupees on 17th September and 25,000 crore rupees on 21st September. The final tranche of 25,000 crore rupees is scheduled for the 28th of this month.
The banking system has been flushed with liquidity primarily due to the heavy mobilization of Foreign Currency Non-Resident deposits, subsequent currency swaps with the central bank, and month-end government expenditure on salaries and pensions.

Title: Foreign Secretary Misri Holds Talks with Japanese Parliamentarians on Strengthening India-Japan Economic Security Partnership
Text:
Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri met a delegation of Japanese Parliamentarians from the Liberal Democratic Party in New Delhi. The delegation is being led by Director General of LDP’s International Bureau, Taro Kono, who has previously served as Japan’s Defence Minister, Foreign Minister and Digital Minister. The delegation is on a five-day visit to India under the India-Japan Distinguished Visitors Programme.
The External Affairs Ministry said in a statement that both sides held productive discussions on continuing the positive momentum in bilateral ties across a host of domains. These include defence, economic security, supply chain resilience, trade and investment, technology, innovation and people-to-people linkages. The visiting delegation noted the impressive strides made by the Indian deep-tech entrepreneurship and research and innovation ecosystem. They made a positive mention of the scope and speed of India’s economic development, including its manufacturing heft and the opportunities it is generating for India and its partner countries. They assessed the need for a more intensive economic security partnership between India and Japan, with an objective to further strengthen de-risking and supply chain resilience.
Both sides underlined the importance of the India-Japan Special Strategic and Global Partnership built on the foundations of political trust, mutual goodwill and a common strategic outlook as an anchor for peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific. They appreciated the need to move quickly to enhance the scope and depth of India-Japan engagement guided by the directions set by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi during the 16th Annual Summit.

Title: India to Remain Key Driver of Global Energy Demand in Coming Decades: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri
Text:
Petroleum and Natural Gas Minister Hardeep Singh Puri today said that India will remain an important driver of global energy demand in the decades ahead. The Minister co-chaired the Seventh High-Level Meeting of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, OPEC -India Energy Dialogue with OPEC Secretary General, Haitham Al Ghais, in New Delhi. They discussed oil market stability, energy security and the importance of adequate and timely investment across the oil industry. Both parties also reviewed the short, medium and long-term outlooks, underscoring India’s crucial role in global economic expansion and energy demand growth.
During the meeting, Mr Puri highlighted that India and OPEC share a naturally complementary and mutually beneficial relationship. The Minister stressed that India values its longstanding engagement with OPEC and its Member Countries, which has contributed significantly to mutual understanding and cooperation on key energy issues. He said that a sustained dialogue between producers and consumers is essential to support investment, strengthen energy resilience and ensure reliable energy supplies for global growth and development. Mr Puri called on OPEC and India to work closely in advancing a balanced, stable and predictable global energy market to promote stability and transparency in global energy markets.
In his remarks, the OPEC Secretary General said that dialogue with India is a priority for OPEC, recognizing India’s importance within the current global energy landscape and the fact that this importance will only increase in the decades ahead. He added that the OPEC-India Energy Dialogue is eleven years strong, having been launched in New Delhi in 2015. He also commended India’s balanced, realistic and pragmatic approach to addressing energy challenges, emphasizing that many of India’s energy priorities are OPEC’s priorities.

Title: PIB Debunks Fake Videos Claiming PM Modi’s Announcements on Purchase of Old Notes and Coins
Text: The Government has debunked several videos circulating on social media claiming that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has made announcements related to the purchase of old notes and coins. The Fact Check Unit of the Press Information Bureau said that these videos are fake and have been created using Artificial Intelligence technology. The Unit clarified that no such announcement has been made by the Prime Minister. It has urged people to remain cautious of such misleading and enticing videos and not to share or forward any suspicious videos or links. The government has advised citizens to believe only official sources for accurate and authentic information on government schemes.

Title: India-Japan Air Forces Conclude Veer Guardian 2026 Exercise at Jodhpur Air Force Station
Text: Indian Air Force and Japan Air Self-Defense Force today concluded the bilateral air exercise Veer Guardian 2026 at Air Force Station Jodhpur. Defence Ministry said that the exercise served as a vital platform for enhancing interoperability and strengthening the strategic partnership between the two Air Forces. During the exercise, the Indian Air Force deployed a mix of aircraft, including Su-30 MKI, Rafale, and indigenous Light Combat Aircraft Tejas. The Japan Air Self-Defense Force participated with the F-2A fighter aircraft. During the joint training spanning 14 days, the two forces engaged in wide range of advanced flying missions, encompassing within-visual-range combat and coordinated multi -aircraft missions. The Ministry said that the exercise concluded as a testament to the enduring friendship and professional camaraderie between the two Air Forces. It said that the engagement continues to pave the way for enhanced collaboration and strategic depth of the defence partnership between India and Japan.

Title: FM Sitharaman Calls for Quality-Driven Growth in India
Text:
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has said that India’s next phase of growth must be built on quality. Addressing the 53rd National Management Convention of the All India Management Association in New Delhi today, Mrs Sitharaman said that every factory floor, boardroom, service centre, Research and Development team must aim for higher standards, fewer defects, and greater reliability. She stressed that management professionals and corporate leaders should make quality consciousness a shared discipline, embedded in products, processes, services and institutions.
Ms. Sitharaman highlighted that the world economy is passing through an unpredictable period and the architecture of global trade and supply chains is also undergoing a parallel shift. The Finance Minister noted that resilience cannot mean retreating into economic isolationism in such an environment. She added that resilience means deep domestic capacity, fiscal strength and industrial scale for India, so that global shocks are absorbed without interrupting national development.
She further said that while global economic growth is slowing to below three percent, the Indian economy continues to expand at close to eight percent. She added that the latest quarter recorded stronger growth than most forecasts.
Ms. Sitharaman said this macroeconomic stability is prompting the world to re-rate India. She noted that on 2nd September 2026, the Japan Credit Rating Agency upgraded India’s long-term foreign currency and local currency issuer ratings from BBB-plus to A-minus, with a stable outlook, and raised the country ceiling to A.

Title: Indian High Commission Cautions Nationals Against Seeking Jobs in Malaysia on Tourist Visa
Text:
The Indian High Commission in Kuala Lumpur has cautioned Indian nationals travelling to Malaysia on tourist visas against taking up employment. In an advisory, the High Commission said that there is a noticeable increase in Indian nationals arriving in Malaysia using the 30-day visa-free facility to seek employment. Many Indian nationals are misled by unscrupulous agents with false job promises, leading to overstay, illegal status, exploitation, detention and legal action. The advisory stated that this is a clear violation of immigration rules, as the visa-free entry facility which permits Indian passport holders to stay in Malaysia for up to 30 days is granted for tourism and social visits only.
The High Commission said genuine tourists must carry valid and verifiable documentation, such as confirmed return ticket, hotel booking, online submission of the Malaysian Digital Arrival Card three days before the arrival date, and a passport with minimum of 6 months’ validity.

Title: PM Modi Stresses Jan Bhagidari for Sustainable Water Security
Text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that water security is a shared responsibility that calls for stronger systems, scientific solutions and Jan Bhagidari. Mr Modi today shared an article written by Union Jal Shakti Minister C.R Patil. Mr Modi noted that C.R Patil has written on India’s efforts to build climate-resilient water management through the Jal Jeevan Mission, Namami Gange, water conservation and technology-driven solutions. The Prime Minister said that the article provides an insightful perspective on how people’s participation, alongside sustained efforts across States and communities, can help secure water for future generations in a sustainable way.

Title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman says India’s next phase of growth must be built on quality
Text: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has said that India’s next phase of growth must be built on quality. Addressing the 53rd National Management Convention of the All India Management Association in New Delhi today, Mrs Sitharaman said that every factory floor, boardroom, service centre, and Research and Development team must aim for higher standards, fewer defects, and greater reliability. She stressed that management professionals and corporate leaders should make quality consciousness a shared discipline, embedded in products, processes, services and institutions.

Title: IMD forecasts heavy to very heavy rain in Andhra Pradesh, Odisha today
Text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast Heavy to Very Heavy Rainfall at isolated places over Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha during the day. Assam, Meghalaya, Chhattisgarh, Gangetic West Bengal and Jharkhand will experience heavy rainfall. Similar conditions are going to prevail over Karnataka, Konkan, Goa, Madhya Maharashtra and Telangana.
According to IMD, Uttarakhand is likely to experience isolated to scattered rainfall from today onwards till friday and West Madhya Pradesh till 28th september. Meanwhile in Delhi there will be mainly clear sky. The maximum and minimum temperatures in the national capital will hover around 34 degree celsius to 25 degree celsius.

Title: GST 2.0 completes one year, simplifies tax structure and improves compliance
Text:
The next-generation Goods and Services Tax, or GST 2.0 reforms, have completed one year today, marking a significant milestone in the country’s indirect tax reform journey. Under the new tax structure, GST Council has simplified the indirect tax system into a two-tier structure of 5%  and 18%from a four-tier structure of 5%, 12 %, 18%, and 28%.
Over the past year, the government has focused on simplifying the tax structure, improving compliance, and strengthening the digital tax ecosystem. GST 2.0 has made registration and return filing easier while speeding up refunds and lowering costs. This has also brought procedural ease for businesses, especially MSMEs and startups. Beyond rate reduction, GST 2.0 is also supporting India’s growth cycle by lowering costs, improving affordability, encouraging compliance and economic activity.

Title: India joins G20 nations in adopting four consensus outcomes on energy, water and critical minerals
Text:
India has joined other G20 nations in adopting four consensus outcomes covering household energy access, infrastructure approvals, water reuse and secure critical-mineral supply chains. At a three-day meeting in Houston, Texas, hosted by the White House National Energy Dominance Council, the departments of Energy and the Interior, and the Environmental Protection Agency.
For homes, they backed scalable options like using liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to quickly replace traditional biomass, which helps developing countries switch to cleaner cooking fuels. They also called for faster and more predictable government permitting processes for energy infrastructure projects.
Additionally, the nations launched a voluntary water-reuse initiative to recycle water based on its quality across farming, manufacturing, and community sectors. Finally, the members agreed to work together voluntarily to secure and diversify the supply chains of critical minerals through shared data, innovation, and joint investments.

Title: National Steering Committee Approves ₹320 Crore for Kurukshetra ITI Cluster Under PM-SETU
Text:
The National Steering Committee (NSC) has approved 320 Crore rupees for Kurukshetra ITI cluster in Haryana under the PM SETU scheme. Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM-SETU) scheme is the government’s flagship initiative to raise the standard of vocational training by inculcating modern infrastructure, industry-led curricula, and strong industry partnerships.
The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship informed that with this approval, the total approved amount under PM SETU has increased to 2491 crore rupees across 10 ITIs clusters. The ministry noted that the increment highlighted the government’s commitment to transform Industrial Training Institutes into future-ready and industry-led centres of excellence.
Minister of State for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Jayant Chaudhary said that bringing industry closer to ITIs will create stronger employment pathways for our youth. He also added that, with strong industry partnerships, the government is working to ensure that young people are equipped with the skills, exposure and opportunities required to participate meaningfully in India’s growth story.

Title: Defence Ministry Signs ₹586 Crore Contract for APUs for T-72 and T-90 Tanks
Text:
The Defence Ministry today signed a contract with Accurate Industrial Controls Private Limited in New Delhi to procure Auxiliary Power Units (APUs) for T-72 and T-90 Tanks at a cost of 586 crore rupees. The contract was signed in presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh.
The Ministry said that the APU is an alternate source for generation of electric power for fire control system, firing circuit, gun stabilisation system and other ancillaries of the tank. The induction of indigenously developed APUs will further strengthen the operational readiness, reliability and sustainability of the Indian Army’s Mechanised Formations. It added that this procurement is a significant step towards indigenisation of critical sub-systems of Armoured Platforms and demonstrates industry-led research and development (Make-II). This also shows the effectiveness of the mechanism in translating indigenous innovation into production and induction.

Title: MoS Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani Reviews Next Phase of Samriddh Gram Initiative
Text:
Minister of State for Communications, Dr Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani today reviewed the next phase of Samriddh Gram initiative with Department of Telecommunications, startups and service partners. In a social media post, Dr Pemmasani said that BharatNet brought fibre to the villages, while Samriddh Gram has facilitated it to work such as health, education, e-governance and livelihood services under one roof, with local help at hand. The Minister noted that during the meeting they discussed innovative models to expand across districts, realising Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s vision of technology at every village’s doorstep.
Dr. Pemmasani also reviewed the India Post Customer 360 self-service platform, which is designed to streamline logistics and operations for business customers. He noted that the platform unifies postal bookings and digital wallet management into a single interface. The platform features real-time analytics, faster bulk processing, and integrated customs query tracking. The Minister said that direct user feedback continues to guide continuous upgrades, ensuring a smarter, faster and more reliable experience for the users.

Title: NHAI Releases New Guidelines for High-Speed Access-Controlled National Highways
Text:
The National Highways Authority of India has released new guidelines for the planning and designing of High-Speed Access controlled National Highways. The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways said that the guidelines will apply to all upcoming 4 and 6 lane Greenfield and Brownfield High-speed access controlled National Highways.
The guidelines seek to bring uniformity in standards for preparation of Detailed Project Reports of high-speed National Highway corridors. It will also bring greater consistency in technical standards, strengthen road safety, improve operational efficiency across the National Highway network. The Ministry said that the guidelines are aligned with the government’ls long-term strategic roadmap which envisages the development of 50 thousand kilometres of access-controlled High-Speed Corridors under Viksit Bharat 2047, boosting connectivity and reducing logistics costs.

Title: Health Minister Nadda Appreciates FUJIFILM India for Dedicating Made-in-India Endoscopy System to Nation
Text:
A delegation from FUJIFILM India, led by Managing Director, FUJIFILM India, Koji Wada, today called on Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare J.P. Nadda in New Delhi. During the interaction, Mr Nadda appreciated FUJIFILM India for dedicating its first serial-numbered ‘Made in India’, Endoscopy System to the nation through AIIMS, New Delhi.
The delegation highlighted the growing role of advanced medical technologies, including flexible endoscopy and minimally invasive treatment, while supporting improved patient outcomes and shorter recovery periods. The potential of such technologies in the diagnosis and management of complex conditions, including pancreatic cancer, was also discussed. The interaction underscored the shared commitment towards strengthening India’s healthcare ecosystem through innovation, advanced medical technology and indigenous manufacturing, in line with the vision of Make In India.

Title: CSIR Launches Science & Innovation Quiz on MY Bharat Portal
Text:
The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) has launched the CSIR Science & Innovation Quiz (CSIR SciQuiz) on the MY Bharat (Mera Yuva Bharat) Portal in association with the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
Launched at the backdrop of 85th Foundation Day of the CSIR, the quiz is being conducted from 20-26 September 2026 which is open to all Indian citizens. The quiz is designed to target youth which will promote scientific awareness, curiosity and public engagement with science.
It will feature MCQs and feature questions related to CSIR’s scientific achievements, technologies, innovations, institutions and contributions to society and the nation. The Ministry of Science and Technology said the initiative will offer participants an engaging opportunity to discover CSIR’s scientific achievements, technologies, innovations and contributions to nation-building. It also added that there will be more such quizzes in coming months on MY Bharat Portal to bring science and innovation closer to society.

Title: EAM S. Jaishankar to lead Indian delegation at 81st Session of UNGA in New York
Text:
External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar will lead the Indian delegation for the High Level Week at the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York, USA. The External Affairs Minister is scheduled to address the High Level Session of the 81st UNGA on the 26th of this month.
During the visit, Dr Jaishankar will also attend various multilateral and bilateral meetings. Dr Jaishankar’s visit to New York comes as world leaders prepare to gather at the UN headquarters for the annual high-level General Debate, scheduled from September 22 to 28. The 81st session of the UN General Assembly is being held under the theme “Restoring trust, managing transformation: A United Nations that delivers for all.”

Title: BJP says Congress is deeply influenced by communist ideology
Text: The BJP today slammed the Congress over a recent remark by former Vice President Hamid Ansari. Addressing a press conference at the party headquarters, BJP spokesperson Sudhanshu Trivedi claimed that Mr Ansari had quoted a book written in 2019, which states that former Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru considered Hindu nationalism a greater threat than communism. Mr Trivedi alleged that the Congress today has moved towards the left and is deeply influenced by communist ideology. He added that the former Vice President’s remarks reflect the mindset of the Congress.

Title: I&B Ministry clarifies permission not denied to any film for screening at 18th International Documentary and Short Film Festival of Keralam
Text: The Information and Broadcasting Ministry has clarified that permission has not been denied to any film for screening at the 18th International Documentary and Short Film Festival of Keralam. Responding to Congress leader Shashi Tharoor’s allegation, the Ministry said that six films have been requested to provide more detailed synopsis. In a social media post, the Ministry said that, depending on the subject of the films, some have been sent to various sectoral authorities for their review. Mr Tharoor had alleged that permission was denied for the screening of 31 films from Keralam at the festival.

Title: Home Minister Amit Shah pays tribute to Lakshmanrao Inamdar on his birth anniversary
Text: Union Home Minister Amit Shah has paid tribute to Lakshmanrao Inamdar on his birth anniversary today. In a social media post, Mr Shah said that Lakshmanrao Inamdar empowered society through his national service, organisation building, and cooperation. The Home Minister added that Lakshmanrao Inamdar gave a new direction and momentum to the cooperative movement in Gujarat and shaped numerous activists like a guardian. He said that the life of Lakshmanrao Inamdar remains an inspiration for all.

Title: Union Law and Justice Ministry to organise workshop under DISHA 2.0 Scheme today
Text:
Union Law and Justice Ministry will organise a workshop under the DISHA (Designing Innovative Solutions for Holistic Access to Justice) 2.0 Scheme today, at the University Auditorium of the India International University of Legal Education & Research, South Goa. Akashvani correspondent reports that the workshop will focus on strengthening access to justice through technology-enabled legal services, legal awareness and pro bono legal assistance.
Best reels created under the “Nyaya Prabodh: Awakening to Justice – Know Your Rights in 90 Seconds” campaign will be showcased on this occasion. A Slogan Competition under Nyaya Prabodh will also be launched during the programme. Another session will focus on the Nyaya Bandhu Pro Bono Legal Services Programme. Through initiatives such as Tele-Law, Nyaya Bandhu, Legal Literacy and Legal Awareness Programmes, and VIDHI-Sanjeevani, the Department of Justice is working towards making legal services more accessible, understandable and affordable to citizens in remote and underserved areas.

Title: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla pays respect to Amrita Devi Bishnoi and martyrs protecting Khejri trees in Khejadli village of Rajasthan
Text:
Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla has paid respects to Amrita Devi Bishnoi and all the martyrs who laid down their lives for the protection of Khejri trees in Khejadli village of Rajasthan during the 18th century. On Khejadli Sacrifice Day today, Mr Birla said that the memory of those environment-loving sacrificers remains an integral part of Rajasthan’s folk consciousness to this day.
In a social media post, he said that the story of Khejadli tells that the concept of environmental conservation is neither new nor modern in India. He added that Rajasthan is not only renowned for its tales of valour, sacrifice, and heroism, but also for a profound tradition of deep faith in nature. The Lok Sabha Speaker further said that the story of Khejadli reminds the citizens of their responsibility towards the environment around them.

Title: Angh, directed by Naga filmmaker, wins Platform Prize 2026 at TIFF
Text:
In a historic first, Angh, directed by Naga filmmaker Theja Rio, has won the Platform Prize 2026 at the Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF). Angh was one of 12 films selected for this year’s platform programme, the TIFF’s only competitive section. Beginning with the 2026 prize, winning the TIFF Platform Prize gives a non-English-language film a direct pathway to eligibility for consideration for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film. Announcing the award, Jury President Pablo Trapero praised Angh for its refreshing perspective, strength of filmmaking and deeply resonant portrait of a world.
The jury also commended Theja Rio for his vision, audacity and courage. In his acceptance speech, Theja Rio thanked the TIFF jury and said the recognition was truly special, as it highlights a film from an Indigenous region and in a tribal language. He said it meant a great deal to the team to represent their people and receive the award. He also thanked his family and friends for their unwavering support. Rio said he came from a small part of Northeast India, where, he noted, dreams do not often come true for his people. He dedicated the award to the people back home, saying that this is just the beginning. The Platform programme champions films with bold directorial vision and distinctive storytelling. The Platform Prize carries a cash award of 20,000 Canadian dollars and a trophy.
The Platform jury this year comprised Pablo Trapero, Amma Asante, Sylvia Chang, Luc Déry and Albert Lee. Nagaland Chief Minister Neiphiu Rio has congratulated Director Theja Rio and the team of ‘ANGH’ on winning the prestigious Platform Prize at the Toronto International Film Festival, TIFF. In a social media post, the Chief Minister said the historic win marks a proud moment for Nagaland and India, and carries a Naga debut onto the Oscar journey. He added that it is also a proud moment for the region and its storytellers on the global stage as ‘ANGH’ brings Naga cinema and its talent into the spotlight. Mr Rio extended his best wishes to the entire team for their journey ahead.

Title: President Droupadi Murmu to embark on 3-day visit to Gujarat beginning today
Text:
President Droupadi Murmu will be on a three-day visit to Gujarat beginning today. She will preside over the presentation ceremony of the 72nd National Film Awards at Ekta Nagar, Kevadia, tomorrow. Akashvani correspondent reports that the National Film Awards, recognising achievements in Indian cinema for the year 2024, will be presented by the President tomorrow. Instituted in 1954, the National Film Awards are among the country’s highest honours for excellence in cinema. Presented annually by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, the awards recognise creative and technical achievements across feature films, non-feature films and writing on cinema.
The winners of the 72nd edition were announced on July 18, 2026, by the chairpersons of the three juries. The awards are divided into three main sections – Feature Films, Non-Feature Films and Best Writing on Cinema – along with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, the highest honour in Indian cinema. The Feature Film section includes awards for Best Feature Film, Best Direction, acting, cinematography, music direction and costume design, among others.
The Non-Feature Film section covers documentaries, short films, animation, arts and culture films, narration or voice-over and script. The Best Writing on Cinema section recognises the best book on cinema and the best film critic. The Dadasaheb Phalke Award follows a separate process, with a specially constituted committee of eminent film personalities recommending the recipient.

Title: CBSE Organises ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat’ Talkathon
Text: The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) organised an interactive Talkathon on the theme ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat’ today on the call of Prime Minister Narendra Modi for a drug-free India. The CBSE said, that the 45-minute programme brought together experts, educators and students to discuss issues related to substance abuse, prevention and the importance of making healthy and responsible choices. The initiative aimed to directly engage students through social media platforms. CBSE invited questions from students and they raised questions concerning mental health, peer pressure and steps for de-addiction.

Title: Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh being organised at various locations across country to eradicate drug abuse among youth
Text:
Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh is being organized at various locations in the country to eradicate drug abuse among youth as part of Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan. The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports has said that Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh is being organised across 1,067 locations in the country. The Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat- 100 Weeks Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan is witnessing nationwide youth mobilisation.
The Ministry added that this programme will be organised across 471 District MY Bharat Offices, along with 596 locations of partner organisations. The Samaroh aims to bring the campaign’s message directly to young people through Nasha Mukt Pledge, Signature Campaign, thematic street plays, slogan writing and youth-led discussions.
As part of the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, several special programmes are being organised across Telangana. Social and voluntary organisations, is participating in this campaign. As part of this initiative, a cycling rally was organised today in Hyderabad with the aim of freeing the youth from the clutches of drugs. As part of the nationwide call, Nasha Mukt Bharat Cycling Ride organised today on Necklace Road, Hyderabad.
BJP Rajya Sabha MP Dr. K. Laxman took part in the rally, cycling alongside youth and cyclists along Necklace Road. Highlighting the severe impact of drugs on the youth, he administered a pledge to the participants. Speaking on the occasion, MP Laxman said a healthy youth is the foundation for building a strong Viksit Bharat, and called upon everyone to join this movement. The event created renewed awareness among youth for a drug-free society.

Title: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Keralam, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and Telangana today
Text: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Telangana during the day. Madhya Maharashtra, Odisha, East Rajasthan, Gangetic West Bengal, Jharkhand, Konkan, Goa, Madhya Pradesh, Marathwada, Telangana and Vidarbha are expected to experience thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds. The Met Department said that similar conditions are expected over Chhattisgarh and other northeastern regions for the day. While in Delhi, the Met Department has forecast partly cloudy sky conditions today and clear skies for the next two days.

Title: India, Japan conduct Air exercise ‘Veer Guardian 2026’ at Air Force Station Jodhpur
Text:
The Indian Air Force (IAF) is conducting the bilateral air exercise Veer Guardian 2026 with the Japan Air Self-Defence Force at Air Force Station Jodhpur. The 14-day exercise, which will be concluded on Tuesday, focuses on advanced operational missions and extensive professional interactions between the two air forces.
The IAF is participating with a diverse mix of frontline combat aircraft, including the indigenous Light Combat Aircraft Tejas, Su-30MKI and Rafale. Japan is participating with F-2A fighter aircraft. Exercise Veer Guardian 2026 reflects the deepening strategic partnership between India and Japan by enhancing tactical proficiency and aerospace operational synergy. The exercise also reaffirms the longstanding bonds of friendship and strategic cooperation between the two countries.

Title: Home Minister Amit Shah pays tribute to Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya on his birth anniversary
Text: Union Home Minister Amit Shah today paid tribute to Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya on his birth anniversary. In a social media post, Mr Shah said that through the establishment of the All World Gayatri Pariwar, Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya paved the way for the cultural upliftment of society. He noted that by harmonizing science and spirituality, Pandit Acharya brought the wisdom of eternal culture to every individual. The Home Minister highlighted that with the mantra ‘Hum Badlenge, Yug Badlega’ he inspired millions of people toward public service and social reform. Mr Shah added that his life and values will forever remain a guiding light for the nation and society.

Title: PM Modi, Union Ministers express grief over demise of journalist Payal Mehta
Text:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has expressed grief over the sudden demise of journalist Payal Mehta today. In a social media post, the Prime Minister described her as a hard-working journalist who remained firmly connected to the ground, bringing a deep understanding of national issues to her reporting.
He added that beyond her work, she will be remembered for the kindness and warmth with which she touched so many lives. Expressing condolences to her family, friends and colleagues, Mr Modi wished god to grant them strength in this difficult hour. Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw today expressed grief over the demise of journalist Payal Mehta. In a social media post, Mr Vaishnaw said that her dedication to reporting was exemplary.
Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has expressed grief over the demise of journalist Payal Mehta today. In a social media post, Mr Singh said that Payal Mehta was an extremely hard-working and dedicated journalist who covered the Parliament beat with great commitment and professionalism. The Minister added that during Parliament sessions, she would be present from early morning till late at night, tirelessly following the proceedings and doing her work with remarkable dedication. He extended condolences to her family and friends in this difficult hour and wished the god to provide them strength to bear this irreparable loss.
Senior journalist Payal Mehta passed away in Mumbai early this morning. She was 46. Ms Mehta, who was visiting the city, rushed to a hospital after experiencing sudden uneasiness early in the morning, where she later breathed her last.

Title: SEMICON India 2026 concludes successfully at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi
Text:
SEMICON India 2026, the fifth edition of India’s flagship semiconductor conference, concluded successfully at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi yesterday. The three-day conference under the theme “Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem” featured over 600 exhibitors. These included around 300 international participants, representatives from 52 countries, and over 150 speakers. Six Country Pavilions representing Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Singapore and Sweden, along with 12 State Pavilions, showcased different dimensions of the semiconductor value chain.
The event recorded 51,656 total registrations and cumulative footfall of about 40,000. Prime Minister Narendra Modi had inaugurated SEMICON India and highlighted India’s progression from policy discussions and project planning to commercial semiconductor production. He interacted with young chip designers and students and virtually inaugurated commercial production lines at CDIL Semiconductor, Mohali, and Suchi Semicon, Surat. The three days witnessed 56 MoUs, announcements and strategic initiatives, spanning semiconductor design, fabrication, advanced packaging, equipment and materials, power electronics, and Artificial Intelligence.

Title: Govt makes Aadhaar biometric authentication mandatory for subsidised refills of LPG cylinders from 1st Oct
Text:
The government has said that Biometric Aadhaar authentication is mandatory for subsidised domestic LPG refills from 1st October this year. Domestic LPG consumers will need to have completed Biometric Aadhaar Authentication to book refills at the regulated Retail Selling Price with applicable subsidy.
Biometric Aadhaar Authentication ensures that subsidised LPG reaches only genuine and deserving households. Linking each connection to the Aadhaar-authenticated consumer will help prevent diversion of subsidised domestic cylinders for commercial and industrial use. It will remove duplicate and ineligible connections, and make subsidy delivery transparent and targeted. The Ministry said the process is not meant to deny LPG to any genuine household, and every eligible consumer has several easy ways to complete it.
It said 27.43 crore consumers have already completed authentication and do not need to do anything further. Authentication can be completed at the time of delivery, at the distributor’s showroom, or on Oil Marketing Company (OMC) mobile apps. The Petroleum and Natural Gas Ministry has urged consumers who have not yet completed Biometric Aadhaar Authentication to do that before 1 October 2026.

Title: Ayush Ministry Advances Use of Artificial Intelligence Across Ayush Systems
Text:
The Ministry of Ayush is advancing the use of Artificial Intelligence in Ayurveda and other Ayush systems, building on the Ayush Grid digital platform. The Ministry has been exploring AI across healthcare, research, education, information services and investment facilitation, with an emerging ecosystem that includes both specialised AI applications and broader collaborations with national AI initiatives. AI-based chatbots including MAISP, eLMS and e-CHARAK along with ARP Research Assistant, are being developed for citizens, researchers, students, medicinal-plant trade, yoga and investment.
The Ministry also highlighted that Yoga Saarthi serves as a yoga recommendation AI chatbot, and Nivesh Saarthi serves as an AI assistant for investment in the Ayush sector. It added that these chatbots demonstrate the expansion of Ayush Grid from digital portals towards interactive, intelligent and user-oriented AI services. The Ministry is also working with IndiaAI and Bhashini, making Ayush Grid portals available in 22 scheduled Indian languages.

Title: BJP chief Nitin Nabin meets Canadian High Commissioner Christopher Cooter
Text: BJP National President, Nitin Nabin today met High Commissioner of Canada to India, Christopher Cooter in New Delhi. In a social media post, Mr Nabin said that during the meeting he briefed Mr Cooter on BJP’s grassroots organisation and the ongoing Seva Sankalp Abhiyan. They also discussed the positive momentum in India-Canada relations. Mr Cooter shared perspectives on opportunities for greater cooperation in skilled workforce mobility, mining and energy, education and critical minerals, as well as the recent exchanges of official and sectoral delegations. They also agreed on the importance of further strengthening political, economic and people-to-people ties between the two countries.

Title: India Dispatches Fresh Tranche of 11 Tonnes of Relief Material to Nepal
Text:
India today dispatched a fresh tranche of 11 tonnes of relief material to Nepal, including medicines, forensics supplies, tents, hygiene kits, sleeping bags and other essential supplies. External Affairs Ministry said that the relief material has been handed over to the Nepali side. This was the 9th Indian Air Force plane carrying relief material to support Nepal’s recovery. In a social media post, External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar said that India continues to support Nepal’s recovery.
Nepal faced devastating floods last month, disrupting life and property. fresh tranche of 11 tonnes of relief material,

Title: Home Minister Amit Shah Congratulates ABVP on Victory in DUSU Elections
Text: Union Home Minister has congratulated the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) on its victory in the Delhi University Students’ Union elections. In a social media post, the Home Minister described the mandate as a reflection of the sentiments of the nation’s youth, noting that students from all across the country study at Delhi University. He added that the result sends a clear message against forces attempting to misuse youth power for anti-national activities.

Title: PIB Fact Check Debunks Fake ‘Dak Seva Gifts’ Scheme Message
Text: The government has debunked a message circulating on social media claiming that gifts are being distributed by India Post under the Dak Seva Gifts scheme. The Fact Check Unit of the Press Information Bureau said that the claim is fake and India Post has no connection to any gift, reward, or lucky draw scheme called Dak Seva Gifts. The Unit has asked citizens to not to click on any suspicious links or websites. It has also urged people to not to share personal information such as bank account details, OTP, or Aadhaar number.

Title: Over ₹200 Crore Approved for Electronic Interlocking in Solapur Division
Text:
Indian Railways has approved the provision of Electronic Interlocking at seven stations of Solapur Division of Central Railway at a cost of over two hundred crore rupees.
The approved work involves the provision of Electronic Interlocking at Mohol, Mundhewadi, Bale, Solapur, Hotgi Junction-Hotgi A Cabin, Shahabad and Wadi Junction on the High Density Network 7 route, where Kavach, Automatic Block Signalling and Centralised Traffic Control works have been sanctioned. Railways Minister said that the modern signalling system will strengthen railway signalling infrastructure across the division and facilitate the implementation of Kavach, the indigenous Automatic Train Protection system.
Electronic Interlocking is a modern computer-based signalling system that replaces conventional relay-based interlocking. It provides more reliable control of points and signals, enables faster fault detection and restoration, facilitates easier maintenance and supports more efficient train operations.

Title: Indian Railways Approves ₹133 Crore for Four-Lane ROB on Udhna-Ukai Songadh Section
Text:
Indian Railways has approved 133 Crore rupees for the construction of a four-lane Road Over Bridge (ROB) on Udhna-Ukai Songadh Section of Western Railway. The Railways Ministry said that the bridge portion will comprise an Open Web Girder, with an estimated cost of over 91 crore rupees.
The Ministry further said that the construction of the four-lane ROB will facilitate smoother movement of road traffic, thereby reducing interference with railway operations. The total cost of the work is to be shared between Indian Railways and the State Government. The grade-separated infrastructure will support smoother train operations and contribute to safer and more efficient railway movement on the Udhna-Ukai Songadh section.

Title: India sends 11 tonnes of relief supplies to flood-affected Nepal
Text:
India has dispatched another 11 tonnes of relief material to Nepal, including medicines, forensic supplies, tents, hygiene kits, sleeping bags and other essential supplies. This was the 9th Indian Air Force plane carrying relief material to support Nepal’s recovery. In a social media post, External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar said that India continues to support Nepal’s recovery.
Nepal faced devastating floods last month, disrupting life and property.

Title: President Droupadi Murmu appoints 14 Judicial Officers as Judges, Additional Judges of five High Courts
Text:
President Droupadi Murmu has appointed 14 Judicial Officers as Judges and Additional Judges of Delhi, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Jharkhand and Karnataka High Courts.
The Ministry of Law and Justice said that the appointments have been made after consultation with the Chief Justice of India. Nivedita Anil Sharma and Nisha Sahay Saxena have been appointed judges of the Delhi High Court.
Five judges have been appointed as additional judges of Delhi High Court, while one judge has been appointed for the Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court. Manoj Prasad, Akhil Kumar, Ram Sharma have been appointed as the judges of the Jharkhand High Court. Furthermore, three judges have been appointed as Additional Judges of the Karnataka High Court

Title: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall across several states and UTs today
Text: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has predicted heavy rainfall over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, Madhya Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Telangana tomorrow. The Met Department has predicted thunderstorms and lightning over Marathwada, Sub Himalayan West Bengal, East Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Konkan, Goa, Odisha and parts of North eastern India tomorrow. Heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely to prevail over parts of Andaman and Nicobar Islands today under the influence of a Low Pressure Area.

Title: India accounts for 20% of global semiconductor design workforce, says MeitY
Text: Secretary of the Ministry of Electronics and IT, S Krishnan, today said that India currently accounts for nearly 20 percent of the world’s semiconductor design workforce. He said that the government has placed substantial emphasis on design talent, with an ongoing program to train approximately 85 thousand design engineers. Talking to the media on the sidelines of SEMICON India 2026 in New Delhi, Mr Krishnan said that the government will give priority to all aspects of skill development, with a strong focus on semiconductor manufacturing.

Title: India, Canada reaffirm commitment to expedite CEPA negotiations to strengthen economic ties
Text:
Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal held a meeting with Canada’s Minister of International Trade, Maninder Sidhu, to discuss advancing negotiations on the India-Canada Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, or CEPA. During the meeting, both sides reaffirmed their commitment to expediting the negotiations and concluding the agreement at the earliest.
The CEPA is expected to create new opportunities in trade in goods and services, investment and other areas of economic cooperation. In a social media post, Mr. Goyal expressed confidence that an early conclusion of the CEPA would help realise the shared vision of significantly increasing bilateral trade and further deepen the India-Canada economic partnership for mutual benefit.

Title: India ranks first in business climate among 41 global markets: Swedish Chamber survey
Text:
India has been ranked first in business climate among forty plus global markets in the latest Business Climate Survey 2026 by the Swedish Chamber of Commerce in India. Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal shared this information in a social media post. He said India’s business climate is setting the gold standard for stability, growth and ease of doing business amid global turbulence.
The Global Business Climate Survey 2026 edition presents insights from 41 markets, offering a broad view of Swedish companies’ perspectives on doing business abroad. The survey aims to provide a framework for comparing economic performance, outlook, and operating conditions over time in key Swedish export markets. It highlights the challenges companies face and identifies opportunities for Swedish companies considering entry into new markets or expansion in existing ones.

Title: PM Modi, UAE President Reaffirm Commitment to Regional Peace and Stability
Text:
India and UAE have reaffirmed their commitment to continued cooperation and coordination in efforts to promote regional peace, security and stability.
