Prime Minister Narendra Modi today received a telephone call from the President of the United Arab Emirates Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. The two leaders exchanged views on developments in West Asia. They also discussed new measures to further deepen the India-UAE Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, including in the areas of energy, defence, technology, investment and health.
The UAE President congratulated the Prime Minister on India’s successful BRICS Presidency. Mr Modi appreciated the participation of Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled in the BRICS Summit and the UAE’s cooperation and partnership in achieving substantive outcomes under India’s Presidency. The UAE President conveyed warm greetings on the Prime Minister’s birthday.

Title: India Expresses Deep Concern Over Escalating Security Situation in Red Sea Region
Text: They also threaten freedom of navigation through the Bab al-Mandab. He said such incidents are totally unacceptable and expressed hope for an early restoration of peace and stability in the region.

Title: EAM Jaishankar Meets Nepalese Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle in New Delhi
Text: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar met Nepalese Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle in New Delhi and discussed ways to strengthen overall cooperation, especially in economic, energy and connectivity domains. Dr Jaishankar also offered condolences on the loss of life and property in the recent flash floods in the neighbouring nation.

Title: Tripura Police Arrest Three Bangladeshi Women, Indian National for Alleged Illegal Entry
Text:
Tripura Police today arrested three Bangladeshi women and an Indian national for allegedly entering India illegally in the Agartala Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport area. According to Airport Police Station Officer-in-Charge Shyamal Debnath, one man and three women were spotted moving suspiciously in the airport area at around 3:30 PM.
They were detained and questioned by the police. During interrogation, police found that the three women were residents of Khulna district in Bangladesh. The Indian national was allegedly taking them, after their illegal entry into Tripura from Bangladesh, to Guwahati by air. All four were subsequently arrested and are scheduled to be produced before a court tomorrow.

Title: NSO Releases District-Level Labour Market Indicators for the First Time
Text: Statistics and Programme Implementation Ministry today released a labour market snapshot of selected districts. The district-level key labour market indicators were released by the National Statistical Office for the first time. Around 57.8% of districts recorded a female Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) of 40% or above. The Worker Population Ratio (WPR) of the top 50% populous districts ranges between 37.3 to 76.7%. Among the 100 most populous districts, Surat in Gujarat recorded the highest levels of LFPR and WPR, while Darbhanga in Bihar recorded the lowest levels of LFPR and WPR. More than 75% of districts have Not in Employment, Education or Training (NEET) rates under 30%.

Title: Manu Bhaker, Tajinderpal Singh Toor Named India’s Flagbearers for Asian Games 2026
Text:
Double Olympic medallist Manu Bhaker and shot-putter Tajinderpal Singh Toor will be India’s flagbearers at the opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2026 at Aichi-Nagoya in Japan tomorrow. Manu Bhaker, who won two bronze medals at the Paris 2024 Olympics, will compete in the women’s 10m air pistol, women’s 25m pistol, and 10m Air Pistol Mixed Team. Tajinderpal Singh Toor will aim to secure his third consecutive Asian Games gold medal in men’s shot put.
The 20th edition of the Asian Games will run from tomorrow to October 4, with more than 500 Indian athletes set to compete across 37 sports. Athletes from 45 countries and regions are competing across 43 sports and 469 medal events in this edition of the Asian Games. Japan will host the continental multi-sport event for the third time, having previously staged it in Tokyo in 1958 and Hiroshima in 1994.
India finished fourth in the Hangzhou medal standings with 107 medals, including 28 gold, 38 silver and 41 bronze, and will be aiming to maintain that momentum in Japan. The Indian contingent will feature five individual Olympic medallists despite the withdrawal of defending javelin throw champion Neeraj Chopra due to an ankle injury. PV Sindhu will spearhead the badminton campaign, while Mirabai Chanu leads the weightlifting contingent. Shooting will feature Manu Bhaker, Lovlina Borgohain will compete in boxing, and Aman Sehrawat will represent India in wrestling.

Title: India’s Forex Reserves Decline by $4.9 Billion to $780.8 Billion
Text: India’s foreign exchange reserves declined by 4.9 billion US dollars (USD) to 780.8 billion US dollars during the week ended the 11th of September. According to the Reserve Bank of India data, Gold reserves declined 2.5 billion USD to 111.2 billion US dollars during the week. Foreign currency assets, the largest component of the reserves, dropped by 2.3 billion USD to 645.7 billion USD. However, Special Drawing Rights gained from 39 million USD to 18.8 billion USD. The country’s reserve position with the International Monetary Fund remained unchanged at 4.9 billion USD.

Title: BJP National President Nitin Nabin Donates Three Months’ Salary to Bihar Flood Relief Fund
Text:
Rajya Sabha MP and BJP National President Nitin Nabin contributed 6 lakh 35 thousand rupees from his three-month salary to the Chief Minister’s Relief Fund for Bihar floods. In a social media post, Mr Nabin said, “The government is continuously monitoring the flood situation in Bihar and is working with full preparedness to ensure timely relief and necessary assistance reaches the affected people.” He added that teams from the National Disaster Response Force and the State Disaster Response Force are deployed for rescue operations, along with arrangements for relief camps, community kitchens, medical facilities, and animal fodder.
The MP further added that the process of assessing crop damage to farmers and providing necessary assistance is also underway. Mr Nabin informed us that the state government has provided a total amount exceeding 550 crore rupees as financial assistance of 7000 rupees per family to families affected by the floods.

Title: Indian-born Cheetah Gives Birth to Four Cubs at Kuno National Park
Text: Project Cheetah has marked a landmark moment, with KGP12, an Indian-born female cheetah, giving birth to four cubs at Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh. This incident occurred just one day after the project completed four years. In a social media post, Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Bhupender Yadav, said that the birth of the four cubs is a beautiful symbol of hope, resilience and the growing success of cheetah conservation in India. He extended his heartfelt congratulations to the entire Kuno and Project Cheetah family.

Title: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited to hand over LCA Tejas and HTT 40 trainer Aircrafts to Indian Air Force
Text: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will grace the handing over ceremony of HAL platforms to the Indian Air Force and Pawan Hans in Bengaluru today. The public sector aviation manufacturer HAL will hand over two LCA FoC trainer aircraft to IAF, four Dhruv Next Generation helicopters to Pawan Hans and the first HTT 40 basic trainer aircraft to the Indian Air Force. A contract for 16 LCA fighter aircraft and four twin seaters in FoC configuration was placed in 2010. HAL plans to deliver 29 MK1A twin seater LCA aircraft to the IAF by 2033-34.

Title: Govt refutes false video claims related to India’s Permanent Representative to UN, Parvathaneni Harish
Text: The Government has refuted a false video circulated by Pakistani propaganda accounts, purportedly showing India’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Parvathaneni Harish. The video falsely claims that, during a UNSC meeting on the Situation in Afghanistan, Mr. Harish said Amnesty International had analysed 2 thousand 596 Indian shipments to Israel since October 2023. The fact check unit of the Press Information Bureau has termed the claim as fake and AI-generated. PIB has further clarified that Ambassador Harish did not make any such statement.

Title: Railways approves Rs 493 cr project for construction of new rail line between Mukutban and Gadchandur in Maharashtra
Text:
Indian Railways has approved a 493 crore rupees project for the construction of around 38 kilometre new rail line between Mukutban (Adilabad) and Gadchandur in South Central Railway. The Railways Ministry today said that the new rail line will provide a shorter and more efficient rail route, reducing travel distance, transportation time and associated costs.
It will also provide an alternative route to decongest the existing Wardha-Manikgarh section, supporting smoother movement of freight traffic. The Ministry noted that Mukutban in Yavatmal district and Gadchandur in Chandrapur district are important industrial and mining centres, and this will strengthen rail connectivity to these industrial clusters and facilitate more efficient movement of freight. The project is also expected to support around six Million Tonnes Per Annum of freight traffic, along with two MEMU trains in each direction per day after commissioning.
The Ministry said that the new line will provide direct connectivity between the coal and cement cluster and the Majri-Nanded route, facilitating shorter leads for coal, cement and Raw Materials for Steel Plants. It will also reduce dependence on the congested Balharshah-Nagpur High-Density Network route, while improving rail connectivity to the relatively less-connected areas of Yavatmal and Chandrapur districts.

Title: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju calls upon citizens to dedicate themselves to building prosperous, strong and developed India
Text:
Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju has called upon citizens to dedicate themselves to building a prosperous, strong and developed India. He said this while addressing the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan in New Delhi, on the occasion of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s birthday. Mr Rijiju said that India has witnessed significant changes in infrastructure, connectivity and food security.
The Minister said that India has transformed under Prime Minister Modi’s leadership. He said that remote border areas are now accessible by motor vehicles, while more than 80 crore people are receiving free foodgrains and other essential commodities. Mr Rijiju said that India is emerging as a strong, secure and stable nation. He also highlighted the government’s commitment to making welfare schemes accessible to all sections of society.
The Minister said that the Ministry of Minority Affairs is working to ensure that its schemes reach minority communities with integrity. He emphasised that development initiatives are intended to benefit every Indian, irrespective of caste, community or creed.

Title: NTA releases final answer keys of UGC-NET June 2026 exam for English, Commerce and Sociology
Text:
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the final answer keys for the UGC-NET June 2026 examination conducted in three subjects: English, Commerce and Sociology. The keys have been made available on the official website https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in/. The examination was held on September 9th and 10th of this month at 454 centres across 272 cities in the country.
The agency had earlier issued a notice on August 16, 2026, regarding the conduct of the test. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now log in to the registration portal using their application number and password to view the final answer keys of their respective subjects. The NTA has advised all candidates to visit the official UGC-NET website regularly for the latest updates related to the examination. For any clarification, candidates may contact the NTA Help Desk through the contact details provided on the website.

Title: IMD forecasts heavy rainfall in Bihar, Odisha, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim, Kerala and Rajasthan today
Text: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall in Bihar, Odisha, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim, Kerala and Rajasthan today. The Met Department has predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds in Uttarakhand, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Konkan, Goa, Karnataka and Lakshadweep today. Similar weather conditions are expected over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Kerala, Mahe, parts of Northeast India and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands during the next two days. The weather agency has forecast a partly cloudy sky in the national capital today.

Title: India asserts to take all necessary steps to ensure energy security after US passes bill
Text:
The government today said that it will take all necessary steps to protect its economic interests and ensure energy security. The External Affairs Ministry said that country remains firmly committed to ensuring energy security for its 140 crore people and will continue to do so through diversified sourcing and on the basis of evolving market dynamics. The statement came amid the passing of a bill by the US House of Representative that will allow US President Donald Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100 per cent on countries such as India and China for procuring Russian crude oil.
The Ministry said that this issue has been discussed at high levels in recent months with various US interlocutors. Its potential implications for not just the bilateral relationship but also the international energy market have been very clearly articulated by the Indian side. The Ministry said that the Indian side has also made clear its determination to take all necessary measures to protect its trade and economic interests. The government made it clear that it will work closely with Indian trade and industry bodies to deal with the implications of these developments.
The sanctions bill was passed by the US Senate last month. The House of Representatives passed the bill in a 262-159 vote last evening. It will become a law once US President signs it. The bill seeks to impose sanctions not only on Russia’s leadership and energy sector, but also on the shadow fleet of vessels that enable Moscow to evade sanctions on oil deliveries. It also seeks to authorise US President to impose stiff tariffs on China, India and other countries to reduce their dependence on Russian oil and gas, as well as additional sanctions on Iran.

Title: Month-long Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan begins  marking PM Modi’s 25 yrs in public service
Text:
BJP’s month-long nationwide Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan has begun from today to mark the completion of 25 years of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s public life and service. As part of the Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan which will continue till 17th of next month, the first day of the campaign is being observed as Seva Diwas, under which blood donation camps have been organised across the country.
Party President Nitin Nabin inaugurated blood donation camp at the Party Headquarters in New Delhi. Mr Nabin along with other party leaders and workers also donated blood. Later talking to media on the occasion, BJP chief said, party workers across the country are participating in these blood donation camp. He noted that under the leadership of the Prime Minister Modi lives of the citizens have been transformed. Mr Nabin said under the leadership of Prime Minister Modi, India is rapidly moving on the path of development to achieve the goal of Viksit Bharat by 2047.
In Delhi, Chief Minister Rekha Gupta performed hawan at Khatu Shyam temple. Later talking to media, Ms Gupta said that she wished for Prime Minister’s long life and good health. She added that, inspired by Mr Modi’s constant emphasis on public service, Delhi government has organised various government-led programs today.

Title: Expansion of Doppler Weather Radars strengthens India’s capacity to understand extreme weather conditions: Dr Jitendra Singh
Text:
Earth Sciences Minister, Dr Jitendra Singh has said that the number of Doppler Weather Radars in the country has increased from fourteen to fifty one in the last twelve years. The Minister said this while virtually inaugurating India’s 51st state-of-the-art Doppler Weather Radar at Sambalpur in Odisha today.
He said that around forty more radars are planned under Mission Mausam. He added that this expansion is part of the Government’s broader effort to strengthen India’s capacity to observe, understand and respond to extreme weather events. He underlined that enhanced observation capabilities are particularly important for regions vulnerable to thunderstorms, lightning, heavy rainfall and other weather-related hazards. Dr Singh also said that the Government is simultaneously expanding a network of ground-based meteorological observation systems. He also highlighted the deployment of advanced observational systems, including radio sonde stations and microwave radiometers, as part of the effort to build a comprehensive and multi-layered weather observation network.
Talking about the radar inaugurated today, Dr Singh said that the Sambalpur radar is significant as it will help bridge an important observational gap in the region. He added that the additional observations generated by the radar will strengthen the ability of meteorological agencies to track weather systems and provide more timely and accurate information to the administration and communities.
Furthermore on the occasion, Dr Singh highlighted the role of India Meteorological Department (IMD) in providing weather forecast for foreign counties. He said that in the spirit of ‘Neighbour First’ and ‘Vishwa Bandhu Bharat’, IMD is providing weather, cyclone and flash-flood forecasting and early warning support to thirteen neighboring countries.

Title: Union Minister Jitendra Singh addresses FICCI conference on digitalisation, AI and automation in mining
Text:
Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh has said that digital technologies can provide greater visibility, prediction, coordination and operational efficiency. The Minister said this while addressing the third edition of FICCI Conference on Digitalisation, AI Automation and Technology Integration in Mining and Metals, Enhancing Competitiveness of the Sector in New Delhi today.
Dr Singh added that process technologies can fundamentally transform the physical production systems through which value is created. During the event, the Minister also launched the FICCI-KPMG report on Mineral Extraction to Metals Production India’s Technology Pivot for Competitiveness.

Title: PM Modi shares former President Ram Nath Kovind’s article on India’s inclusive development
Text:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has shared an article written by former President Ram Nath Kovind highlighting India’s inclusive development trajectory.
In a social media post, Mr Modi noted that the former President has brought into focus the government’s core policy of Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas, emphasising that the periphery is now moving to the centre of the nation’s development ambitions. In the article, Mr Kovind highlighted how India’s growth story is increasingly bringing those who were previously unheard, unseen, or underserved into the national mainstream.

Title: PM Modi shares PV Sindhu’s article on India’s evolving opportunities for young talent
Text:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi has shared an article written by athlete PV Sindhu in which she described how India never lacked talent but often missed opportunities and pathways to realise big dreams.
Sharing a social media post, the Prime Minister noted that the article reflects on how the last 12 years have changed this, enabling a new generation of Indians not just to dream big, but to turn those dreams into reality.

Title: 147th birth anniversary of Self-Respect Movement founder Thanthai Periyar observed today
Text:
Today is the 147th birth anniversary of E.V.Ramasamy called Thanthai Periyar, the founder of the Self-Respect Movement. Chief Minister C.Joseph Vijay, in his social media message, said that this is a day when we celebrate self-respect, social justice and equality.
Tamil Nadu Speaker JCD Prabhakar and State Ministers paid floral tributes to the statue of Periyar situated at Mount Road in Chennai. Chief Minister Vijay will administer the pledge at the Secretariat today.

Title: ED conducts searches in Delhi, Bihar, Jharkhand and Karnataka over Ranchi RSS office blast
Text: Enforcement Directorate’s Delhi zone has conducted Search operations at four premises located across Delhi, Bihar, Jharkhand, and Karnataka today. The search operations are being carried out in connection to case related to a bomb attack on the RSS office in Ranchi in June this year.

Title: Former Union Minister and Congress leader Sudarshana Nachiappan passes away at 78
Text:
Former Union Minister and Congress leader Sudarshana Nachiappan passed away due to illness at his residence at Sivaganga today. The 78-year-old leader represented Sivaganga in Lok Sabha from 1999 to 2004.
Later, he was also nominated to the Rajya Sabha. He served as a Minister of State during late Prime Minister Manmohan Singh’s tenure. He was also an advocate in the Supreme Court.

Title: PM Modi thanks people worldwide for birthday wishes, shares ‘Ashirwad Ka Diya’ song
Text:
On Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s birthday today, wishes and affectionate gestures are pouring in from across the globe. Responding to these gestures, Mr Modi reposted a song titled Ashirwad Ka Diya, composed by Aman Pant, on his social media account.
Expressing his gratitude, the Prime Minister said that such gestures and blessings hold a very special place in his heart. He added that every blessing strengthens his resolve to serve the people of the nation with even greater dedication and devotion.

Title: India commits to energy security through diverse sourcing, says MEA
Text:
India remains firmly committed to ensuring energy security for its 1.4 billion people and will continue to do so through diversified sourcing and on the basis of evolving market dynamics. Noting the passage of the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act in the US Congress, the External Affairs Ministry stated that it is monitoring further developments on this matter.
According to the ministry, this issue has been discussed at high levels in recent months with various US interlocutors. Its potential implications for not just the bilateral relationship but also the international energy market have been very clearly articulated by the Indian side.
The Ministry further said that the Indian side has also made clear its determination to take all necessary measures to protect its trade and economic interests. Government will work closely with Indian trade and industry bodies to deal with the implications of these developments.

Title: Govt proposes amendments to Drugs Rules(1945) to strengthen oversight of Schedule H, H1 and X drugs
Text:
The Union Ministry of Family Welfare has proposed amendments to Drugs Rules, 1945, to strengthen regulatory oversight of Schedule H, H1 and X Drugs. These drugs require valid prescriptions for customers to purchase. The proposed amendment seeks to address concerns relating to unauthorised access to and sale of these drugs and recommends mandatory CCTV surveillance at medical stores as an additional regulatory safeguard.
The Ministry said, upon implementation, the proposed amendment is expected to help strengthen monitoring of the sale and distribution of these drugs and curb their unauthorised access and sale without valid prescriptions. The proposed CCTV surveillance mechanism will also enhance transparency and accountability across the pharmaceutical supply chain, thereby strengthening safeguards for public health.
The Ministry has invited objections and suggestions from stakeholders and members of the public on the proposed amendment within 30 days.

Title: PM Modi shares Zoho Chief Scientist Sridhar Vembu’s article on India’s deep-tech growth
Text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has shared an article written by Chief Scientist of Zoho, Sridhar Vembu which highlights India’s semiconductors, space, defence and AI are being built. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that the article showcases India’s rapidly evolving deep-tech capability and shows how the country is now choosing to do more of the difficult learning itself.

Title: Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026 begins across country
Text:
The Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026 has started across the country from today. The theme of this campaign is Swachhata Mein Sahbhag; Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat.
This year’s Swachhata Hi Seva campaign is centred around five key pillars. These pillars are: Transformation of cleanliness target units and clean public places, Swachh Paathshala: Yuva for Swachhata, Safai Mitra Suraksha Evam Samman Shivir, Jan Bhagidari for Swachhata, and Swachhata Se Samriddhi. The campaign mobilises citizen action and ownership for Swachhata, adopting a Whole of Government and Whole of Society approach, with a focus on shared responsibility, sustained cleanliness and participation across rural and urban India.
Alongside the five campaign pillars, the campaign places people and Jan Bhagidari at the centre, with additional emphasis on awareness of the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 and the roles and responsibilities of different stakeholders, including four-way source segregation. Sharing details of this year’s campaign, Jal Shakti Minister C R Patil said that on the occasion of world tourism day, special focus will be on cleaning of tourist sites including high footfall areas, and tourist centric beaches. On 1st October, simultaneous voluntary shramdaan and cleanliness drives across the country will be held under Ek Din, Ek Ghanta and Ek Saath.

Title: India rejects Pakistan-China Boundary Joint Commission as legally invalid
Text:
India has rejected the so-called Pakistan-China Boundary Joint Commission, saying Pakistan has no locus standi to enter into arrangements concerning Indian territory under its illegal and forcible occupation.
Spokesperson of the Ministry of External Affairs Randhir Jaiswal said this while responding to media queries yesterday. He said the Ministry has seen reports in this regard and India’s position is clear and consistent. He said there is no boundary between Pakistan. Mr Jaiswal said, New Delhi rejects the Pakistan-China Boundary Joint Commission, which is without any legal basis.
The spokesperson reiterated that the Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh have been, are, and will always remain integral and inalienable parts of India. He said India has never recognised the so-called 1963 China-Pakistan Boundary Agreement and has consistently maintained that it is illegal and invalid.
The MEA spokesperson said, New Delhi resolutely opposes and rejects any attempt to alter the status of the occupied territories or legitimise what it calls illegal occupation. New Delhi called upon Pakistan to immediately vacate areas under its illegal and forcible occupation instead of engaging in such theatrics.

Title: Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026 centred around five key pillars: Union Jal Shakti Minister
Text:
Union Jal Shakti Minister C R Patil, along with Minister of State for Jal Shakti V Somanna and Minister of State for Housing and Urban Affairs Tokhan Sahu, today launched the Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign 2026. The theme of this campaign is Swachhata Mein Sahbhag; Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat. Addressing the media during the curtain raiser press conference this evening, Mr Patil said this year’s Swachhata Hi Seva campaign is centred around five key pillars. The five pillars include transformation of cleanliness target units and clean public places, Swachh Paathshala: Yuva for Swachhata, SafaiMitra Suraksha Evam Samman Shivir, Jan Bhagidari for Swachhata, and Swachhata Se Samriddhi.
The Minister said, on the occasion of world tourism day, special focus will be on cleaning of tourist sites including high footfall areas, and tourist centric beaches. On 1st October, simultaneous voluntary shramdaan and cleanliness drives across the country will be held under Ek Din, Ek Ghanta and Ek Saath will be organised. This year’s campaign aims to mobilise citizen action and ownership for Swachhata, adopting a Whole of Government and Whole of Society approach, with a focus on shared responsibility, sustained cleanliness and participation across rural and urban India. Sharing the last year’s campaign achievement, Mr Patil said around 18 crore people participated in Swachhata Hi Seva campaign 2025, including 13.91 crore participants in rural India and 4.53 crore in urban India.

Title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman calls for mature tax policy debate keeping national interest first
Text:
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has stressed that tax-related proposals to the government must keep the nation first, over and above seeking rate reduction, exemption or concessions.
She was speaking at the inaugural of two days Conference on New Age Taxation organised by the International Tax Research and Analysis Foundation in Bengaluru today.
The minister called upon the academics, researchers and think tanks to make Independent tax policy research a regular part of public discourse that can be examined, challenged and improved.
Speaking about the pre-budget consultation by her ministry, Ms Sitharaman said that these exercises must raise larger questions on what kind of a tax system India should have over the next two decades as we move towards Viksit Bharat 2047.
She insisted for better tax research that looks at all sides, measures its effects, recognises the trade-offs, and offers workable alternatives for every revenue loss to the exchequer and helps the Government to shape the choices from which good tax policy can emerge.

Title: Twenty NCC girl cadets successfully complete ‘Aparajita-ParangLa 2026’ the High Altitude Long Trek in Ladakh
Text:
Twenty National Cadet Corps (NCC), girl cadets have successfully completed the ‘Aparajita-ParangLa 2026’ High Altitude Long Trek in Ladakh.
The cadets covered approximately two hundred fifty kilometres over 30 days and the route passed through high-altitude terrain, including glaciers, snowfields and river valleys. The team completed the trek from Kibber in Himachal Pradesh to Karzok in Ladakh, accompanied by officers, instructors, medical staff, and support staff.
The expedition was flagged in at Karzok, Ladakh, today by Director General NCC, Lieutenant General Virendra Vats, and Additional Secretary in the Ministry of Defence, Dipti Mohil Chawla.
Speaking on the occasion, Lieutenant General Virendra Vats congratulated the cadets and staff on the successful completion of the expedition. He said such activities help develop leadership, self-confidence, teamwork and endurance among the youth.
The Defence Ministry said that the All India Girls High Altitude Long Trek was organised to encourage young women to participate in adventure activities and provide them exposure to challenging high-altitude conditions. The trek was flagged off by Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh from New Delhi on 18th August.
